message: Còn rất nhiều chương dịch không đúng quy tắc, chú thích, giải nghĩa thừa thãi
root_cause: The translation agent is appending English/Latin terms in parentheses next to the Vietnamese terms to explain them, and retaining author notes, violating the rule of no annotations without explicit instructions.
fix_applied: Added explicit forbidden patterns to global_config.json to block parenthetical explanations. Updated translation_config.json to forbid bilingual annotations.

message: Duplicated grammar rules and missing global sync call during promote
root_cause: sync_analysis_global.py used append mode without deduplication, and update_analysis_state.py did not call global sync after promotion.
fix_applied: Added dictionary-based deduplication logic inside sync_analysis_global.py before appending to global_grammar_rules.jsonl, and added a call to sync_analysis_to_global in update_analysis_state.py.

message: AI Agent only wrote 1 sample aligned_segment per chapter instead of full analysis
root_cause: No minimum segment count validation in validate_analysis.py and no explicit rules in analysis_instructions telling AI to produce full segments
fix_applied: 1) Added MIN_SEGMENTS=5 check in validate_analysis.py 2) Added segment_rules/entity_rules/term_rules in build_context_pack.py analysis_instructions 3) Created regen_analysis.py script for retroactive fix 4) Fixed name_source/name_target lookup in regen_analysis.py

message: Double output requirement caused misalignment between source and translated_text.
root_cause: The AI was prompted to output translated_text and aligned_segments separately. Due to token limits or script processing (regen_analysis.py splitting texts mechanically by different delimiters), the mapping misaligned drastically.
fix_applied: Unified the prompt. AI now ONLY outputs aligned_segments (and other analysis). validate_translation.py reconstructs translated_text by joining target fields. Deleted regen_analysis.py. Added retroactive_ai_aligner.py to fix old data using AI natively.
